summary.headline: Zodiacal Sign Classifications
summary.text: Astrological classification of zodiac signs as leading, sub-leading, subordinate, terrestrial, and aquatic, with examples of their effects on rank, marriage, children, injury, universal events, nativities, and beginnings. Aries, Leo, Sagittarius, Gemini, Libra, Aquarius, and the water-associated signs are related to the Sun, Jupiter, Saturn, and Mercury.
